metadata.title: Through Fire
metadata.description: Prepare the supplies for a permanent village route through the Nether.

tracker.text: Bring 10 obsidian for a route portal.
Bring 4 magma cream for fire resistance.

offer.label: Through Fire
lines: One portal is an escape. A marked portal with supplies can become a road.
Bring the frame, a way to light it, and enough magma cream to survive the first mistake.
Bring 10 obsidian, 2 fire charges, and 4 magma cream. I will make the reward worth the trouble.
